landing.introduction: With a range of built-in and extensible Modes, Bolt Code lets you plan, architect, code, debug and boost your productivity like never before.

providerSignup.heading: Choose your provider
providerSignup.chooseProvider: Bolt Code needs an LLM provider to work. Choose one to get started, you can add more later.

telemetry.helpImproveMessage: Telemetry is off by default. If you like, you can help us fix bugs and improve the extension by enabling anonymous error and usage reporting in <settingsLink>settings</settingsLink>. No code, prompts, or personal information is ever collected.
